input: Sign up for a local community first aid class

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: First aid classes vary widely — basic CPR, full first aid certification, paediatric focus, wilderness first aid, etc. The type determines which providers and courses to look for.
Knowing whether this is for the user alone or a group (e.g. family, work team) affects whether a group booking or individual registration is needed.
The user's specific location or city is essential to finding classes that are actually local and accessible to them.
The user may have a deadline (e.g. needing certification by a specific date for a job), which narrows which upcoming sessions are viable.
Class costs range from free community sessions to paid certified courses; budget determines which options are realistic.
Some users prefer in-person hands-on training while others may accept a blended or online format — this affects which providers qualify.
Whether the user needs an officially recognised certificate (e.g. Red Cross, St John's) or just wants general knowledge changes which courses count as 'done well'.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a local community first aid class
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a first aid class available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What type of first aid training are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify the specific course type the user needs — e.g. basic CPR only, standard first aid, paediatric first aid, or wilderness first aid.

questions.title: Which city or neighbourhood should the class be in?
questions.description: Pin down the user's location so searches can be targeted to genuinely local providers.

questions.title: Is this just for you, or for a group of people?
questions.description: Determine whether an individual spot or a group/corporate booking is needed.

questions.title: Do you have a date by which you need to be certified?
questions.description: Establish any deadline that limits which upcoming class sessions are suitable.

questions.title: What is your budget for this class?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with, from free community sessions to paid certified courses.

questions.title: Do you prefer fully in-person, or is a blended format acceptable?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user requires hands-on in-person training or would accept an online theory component combined with a practical session.

questions.title: Do you need an officially recognised certificate at the end?
questions.description: Determine whether formal accreditation (e.g. Red Cross, St John Ambulance) is required, or whether general skills and knowledge are the goal.
